task.description: Validate the design artifact for ISS-0618
acceptance_criteria: Design covers both TC-SCH-02-02 and TC-SCH-02-03 root causes

result.summary: Design PASS. Both root causes identified with specific line numbers in src/scheduler/scheduler.zig. Fix plan: (1) add non-locking EXISTS probe before FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED to distinguish locked rows from no-rows; (2) propagate SchedulerError.TransactionFailed when fire path fails (after handleTimerFireError records the failure for retry/DLQ). Risk analysis covers all 39 pollDueTimers callers — none in production code, only tests, most on happy path. Acceptance criteria cover the 2 failing tests + regression of others.
result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (WF-03 Step 3) for implementation
